recipes.name: Chicken parmesan
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced in half sideways into 4 thin cutlets
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help slice the chicken into thin cutlets.
Season the chicken with salt.
Set up 3 dishes: flour, eggs, and panko mixed with parmesan and seasoning.
Coat each cutlet in flour, then egg, then the crumbs. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big oven-safe pan over medium-high heat and fry the cutlets for 3 minutes per side, until golden.
Spoon marinara over each cutlet and top with mozzarella.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the cheese bubbles and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Serve over spaghetti with more sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken fettuccine Alfredo
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts (optional)
steps: Season the chicken with 1/2 teaspoon salt and cook in the oil over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C). Rest and slice. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the fettuccine in salted water as the package says. Save 1/2 cup of pasta water and drain.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat and add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cream and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until slightly thick.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the parmesan until smooth.
Toss in the pasta, the rest of the salt and pepper, adding pasta water if it's too thick.
Top with the chicken and parsley.

recipes.name: Baked ziti
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) ground beef or Italian sausage
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Boil the pasta for 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain.
Cook the meat in a big pan over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat and stir in the marinara and tomato sauce.
Mix the ricotta, egg, half the parmesan and the seasoning.
Toss the pasta with the meat sauce.
Spread half in a 9 by 13 inch dish, dot with the ricotta mix and sprinkle with half the mozzarella.
Add the rest of the pasta and top with the rest of the mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then uncover and bake for 15 minutes more, until bubbly.

recipes.name: Classic beef lasagna
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the beef, sausage and onion in a big pot over medium heat for 10 minutes, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, water, seasoning and 1 teaspoon salt and simmer for 30 minutes.
Boil the noodles as the package says, drain and lay them flat on oiled foil.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix the ricotta, egg, half the parmesan and the rest of the salt.
In a 9 by 13 inch dish, layer: 1 cup sauce, 4 noodles, a third of the ricotta, a quarter of the mozzarella, sauce. Repeat twice, then finish with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover with foil (sprayed so it won't stick) and bake for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake for 25 minutes more, until bubbly.
Rest for 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) guanciale, pancetta or thick bacon, diced
1 cup (100 g) finely grated pecorino or parmesan, plus more to serve
steps: Dice the bacon. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the eggs, yolk, cheese and pepper in a bowl.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Cook the bacon in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp. Turn off the heat.
Add the drained hot pasta to the bacon pan and toss.
Wait 1 minute, then pour in the egg mix and 1/4 cup of pasta water and toss fast with tongs.
Keep tossing, adding splashes of pasta water, until creamy and glossy. The heat of the pasta cooks the eggs into a sauce. If it looks runny, warm over very low heat for 30 seconds while tossing.
Serve right away with more cheese and pepper.

recipes.name: Cacio e pepe
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) very finely grated Pecorino Romano
steps: Boil the pasta in a smaller amount of salted water than usual so the water gets starchy. Cook for 1 minute less than the package says.
Toast the pepper in a big dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add 1/2 cup of pasta water and the butter to the pepper.
Scoop 1/2 cup more pasta water into a bowl and let it cool for 1 minute, then whisk in the cheese to a smooth paste.
Move the pasta into the pepper pan with tongs and toss for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Take the pan off the heat, add the cheese paste and toss fast, adding pasta water until creamy.
Serve right away.

recipes.name: Spaghetti aglio e olio
steps: Slice the garlic thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Put the oil and garlic in a big cold pan and heat over medium-low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until the garlic is light golden. Don't let it go brown or it turns bitter.
Add the chili flakes for 10 seconds, then 1/2 cup pasta water.
Add the drained pasta, parsley and salt and toss for 1 minute, adding more water until glossy.
Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta primavera
steps: Cut all the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the pasta in salted water as the package says. Add the broccoli for the last 2 minutes. Save 1 cup of pasta water and drain.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the zucchini and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, peas and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the pasta, broccoli, butter, parmesan, lemon zest and juice, salt and 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss until glossy and serve with more parmesan.

recipes.name: Creamy penne alla vodka
ingredients: 1 small onion or shallot, finely chopped
1/4 cup (60 ml) vodka, or use pasta water instead
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the penne in salted water as the package says. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until it turns darker red.
Add the vodka (an adult should do this, away from the flame) and simmer for 1 minute.
Stir in the cream, salt and chili flakes.
Add the pasta, parmesan and splashes of pasta water and toss until silky. Top with basil.

recipes.name: Mushroom risotto
ingredients: 6 cups (1.4 liters) chicken or vegetable broth
1/2 cup (120 ml) white wine or more broth
steps: Keep the broth warm in a pot over low heat.
Slice the mushrooms and chop the onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the mushrooms in 1 tablespoon butter and the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned. Lift out.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes. Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add 1 ladle of warm broth and stir until it's mostly absorbed. Keep adding broth one ladle at a time, stirring often, for 18 to 22 minutes, until the rice is creamy but still a little firm.
Stir in the mushrooms, the rest of the butter, parmesan and salt.

recipes.name: Baked eggplant parmesan
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced into 1/2 inch rounds
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help slice the eggplant.
Sprinkle the slices with salt, wait 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Mix the panko, half the parmesan and the seasoning.
Dip each slice in egg, then the crumbs, and lay on 2 oiled baking sheets. Spray the tops.
Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden.
Turn the oven to 375°F (190°C). Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and parmesan in a 9 by 13 inch dish, twice over, ending with sauce and cheese.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until bubbly. Rest for 10 minutes and top with basil.

recipes.name: Spinach and ricotta stuffed shells
ingredients: 1 package (10 oz / 285 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Boil the shells for 2 minutes less than the package says. Drain and lay them apart on a tray so they don't stick.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, 1 cup mozzarella, half the parmesan, egg, garlic and salt.
Spread 1 cup of marinara in a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Fill each shell with a heaping spoonful of the filling and set it in the dish.
Pour the rest of the sauce over and top with the rest of the cheeses.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 minutes more, until bubbly.

recipes.name: Homemade potato gnocchi
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups (160 g) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
steps: Bake the whole potatoes at 400°F (200°C) for 50 to 60 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help.
While still hot, cut in half, scoop out the insides and mash or rice until smooth with no lumps. Let cool for 10 minutes.
Mix in the egg yolk and salt, then the flour, and knead gently for 1 minute into a soft dough. Don't overwork it.
Roll pieces into ropes 3/4 inch thick and cut into 1 inch pieces.
Boil the gnocchi in salted water in batches. When they float, cook for 1 minute more, then lift out with a slotted spoon.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat with the sage for 2 to 3 minutes, until nutty and golden.
Toss the gnocchi in the butter for 1 minute and top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Italian sausage and peppers
ingredients: Hoagie rolls or cooked pasta to serve
steps: Slice the peppers, onion and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Brown the sausages in the oil in a big pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Lift them out.
Cook the peppers and onion in the pan for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, oregano and salt for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes if using, and put the sausages back.
Cover and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, until the sausages are 160°F (71°C) inside.
Serve in rolls or over pasta.

recipes.name: Chicken piccata
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced in half sideways
steps: Slice the chicken into thin cutlets. Ask an adult to help.
Season with salt and pepper and dust with flour. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Move to a plate.
Turn the heat to medium, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the broth, lemon juice and capers.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, scraping the pan, until reduced by half.
Turn off the heat and swirl in the rest of the butter.
Put the chicken back, spoon the sauce over, and top with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken marsala
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced in half sideways
3/4 cup (180 ml) dry Marsala wine, or chicken broth plus 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
steps: Slice the chicken into thin cutlets and the mushrooms. Ask an adult to help.
Season the chicken with salt, dust with flour, and wash your hands.
Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C). Move to a plate.
Add 1 tablespoon butter and the mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes, until browned. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the Marsala (an adult should do this) and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the broth and simmer for 4 minutes, until reduced. Stir in the cream and the rest of the butter.
Put the chicken back to warm for 1 minute and top with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken cacciatore
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Wash your hands.
Slice the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken skin side down for 5 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms for 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, oregano and rosemary and put the chicken back.
Cover and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Add the olives and serve with pasta, polenta or bread.

recipes.name: Pasta puttanesca
ingredients: 1 can (28 oz / 800 g) whole peeled tomatoes, crushed by hand
1/2 cup (70 g) pitted black olives, halved
steps: Slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the garlic, anchovies and chili flakes for 2 minutes, mashing the anchovies.
Add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, until thick.
Toss the drained spaghetti in the sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Top with parsley.

recipes.name: Pasta pomodoro
ingredients: 1 can (28 oz / 800 g) whole San Marzano tomatoes
steps: Slice the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the garlic for 1 to 2 minutes, until just golden.
Add the tomatoes and crush them with a potato masher. Add the salt and chili flakes.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water as the package says, then drain.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce, butter and torn basil. Serve with parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta all'amatriciana
ingredients: 6 oz (170 g) guanciale or pancetta, cut in strips
steps: Cut the guanciale and slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the guanciale in the oil in a big pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp at the edges.
Add the onion and chili flakes and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Boil the pasta in salted water as the package says.
Toss the pasta in the sauce with half the pecorino and a splash of pasta water.
Serve with the rest of the cheese.

recipes.name: Cheese and pepperoni calzones
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pizza dough, store-bought or homemade
1 cup (240 ml) marinara sauce, warm, for dipping
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the ricotta, mozzarella, parmesan and seasoning.
Split the dough into 4 pieces and roll each into an 8 inch circle.
Put a quarter of the cheese and pepperoni on half of each circle, leaving a 1 inch border.
Fold over and pinch and roll the edges to seal.
Set on a lined sheet, brush with egg and cut 2 small slits on top.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden brown.
Cool for 5 minutes and serve with marinara for dipping.

recipes.name: Shrimp scampi with linguine
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/2 cup (120 ml) white wine or chicken broth
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Boil the linguine in salted water as the package says. Save 1/2 cup pasta water.
Season the shrimp with salt. Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink. Move to a plate.
Turn the heat to medium, melt the butter and cook the garlic and chili flakes for 1 minute.
Add the wine and lemon juice and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the linguine, shrimp, zest, parsley and pasta water and toss until glossy.

recipes.name: Creamy Tuscan chicken
ingredients: 4 thin boneless skinless chicken breasts or cutlets
1/2 cup (55 g) sun dried tomatoes, chopped
steps: Season the chicken with salt and seasoning. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C). Move to a plate.
Chop the garlic and sun dried tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat to medium and cook the garlic and tomatoes for 1 minute.
Add the cream and broth and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan and spinach until wilted.
Put the chicken back and spoon the sauce over. Serve with pasta or bread.

recipes.name: Coq au vin
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
2 cups (480 ml) dry red wine, or chicken broth with 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
steps: Season the chicken. Chop the bacon and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big heavy pot over medium heat for 6 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out.
Brown the chicken in the bacon fat for 5 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion, carrots and mushrooms for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, flour and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the wine and broth, scraping the pot. The alcohol cooks off as it simmers.
Add the chicken, bacon, thyme and bay leaves, cover and simmer on low for 1 hour, until the chicken is very tender and well over 165°F (74°C).
Take out the herbs and serve with mashed potatoes or bread.

recipes.name: Beef bourguignon
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) beef chuck, cut in 2 inch cubes
3 cups (720 ml) dry red wine, or beef broth with 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pat the beef dry and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the bacon in a big oven-safe pot over medium heat for 6 minutes. Lift it out.
Add the oil and brown the beef in 3 batches for 5 minutes each. Lift it out.
Cook the carrots and onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, tomato paste and flour for 1 minute.
Add the wine, broth, thyme, bay leaves, beef and bacon and bring to a simmer.
Cover and bake for 2 hours 30 minutes to 3 hours, until the beef is fork tender.
Brown the mushrooms and pearl onions in the butter for 8 minutes and stir them into the stew. Take out the herbs.

recipes.name: Bratwurst with sauerkraut and onions
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) chicken broth or apple juice
steps: Slice the onion and apple. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and brown the bratwurst for 6 to 8 minutes, turning. Lift them out.
Cook the onion and apple in the pan for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the sauerkraut, broth and caraway and nestle the bratwurst back in.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until the bratwurst are 160°F (71°C) inside.
Serve in buns with the sauerkraut and onions and lots of mustard.

recipes.name: Baked chicken cordon bleu
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put each breast between plastic wrap and pound it to an even 1/4 inch thick.
Season with salt and pepper and lay a slice of ham and cheese on each.
Roll up tightly and close with toothpicks.
Coat each roll in flour, then egg, then panko. Wash your hands.
Set on a lined baking sheet and drizzle with the melted butter.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C) in the middle.
Take out the toothpicks before serving.

recipes.name: Salmon in parchment
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Fold each sheet of parchment in half to make a crease, then open it.
Lay zucchini and tomatoes next to the crease, then a salmon fillet.
Season with salt and pepper and top with lemon slices, butter and dill.
Fold the paper over and crimp the edges in small folds to seal tightly.
Bake on a baking sheet for 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon is 145°F (63°C).
Cut the packets open carefully at the table. Hot steam comes out.

recipes.name: Chicken and shrimp paella
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
1 1/2 cups (300 g) short grain Spanish rice like bomba, or arborio
steps: Cut the chicken and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big wide pan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken and chorizo for 6 minutes. Lift out.
Cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, paprika and saffron for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes, broth, salt, chicken and chorizo.
Bring to a boil and spread the rice evenly. Don't stir from now on.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until most of the liquid is gone.
Push the shrimp into the rice and scatter the peas. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes, until the shrimp are pink and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Turn the heat up for 1 to 2 minutes to crisp the bottom. Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Pork schnitzel
ingredients: 2 large eggs, beaten with 1 tablespoon milk
steps: Put each chop between plastic wrap and pound it to 1/4 inch thick with a meat mallet or rolling pin.
Season with salt and pepper.
Coat each in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, without pressing hard. Wash your hands.
An adult heats 1/4 inch of oil and the butter in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side, swirling the pan so oil washes over the top, until puffed and golden and cooked through. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Swedish meatballs
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes.
Mix in the meats, egg, onion, salt, allspice and nutmeg and roll into 1 inch balls. Wash your hands.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a big pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until 160°F (71°C) inside. Lift out.
Melt the butter in the pan and whisk in the flour for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the broth, then the cream and Worcestershire, and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Put the meatballs back for 2 minutes.
Serve with mashed potatoes or egg noodles and lingonberry jam.

recipes.name: Beef stroganoff
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb (570 g) sirloin steak, thinly sliced
steps: Slice the beef, onion and mushrooms. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef and sear it in the oil in a big pan over high heat in 2 batches for 1 to 2 minutes, until browned. Lift it out.
Melt the butter over medium heat and cook the onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the broth, Worcestershire and mustard.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Turn the heat to low, stir in the sour cream, and add the beef to warm for 1 minute. Don't let it boil.
Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.name: Mushroom stroganoff
steps: Slice the mushrooms and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil and butter in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the mushrooms in 2 batches for 6 to 8 minutes, until browned. Lift out.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour, then whisk in the broth, soy sauce and mustard. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Put the mushrooms back, turn the heat to low and stir in the sour cream and salt.
Serve over noodles with parsley.

recipes.name: Potato and cheese pierogi
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
steps: Mix the flour, salt, egg, sour cream, water and melted butter into a soft dough. Knead for 5 minutes, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, until soft. Drain and mash with the cheese and a pinch of salt. Cool.
Chop the onion and cook it in 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat for 10 minutes, until golden. Ask an adult to help.
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut 3 inch circles.
Put 1 tablespoon of filling on each, fold over and pinch the edges tightly shut.
Boil in batches in salted water. When they float, cook for 2 minutes more.
Fry the boiled pierogi in the rest of the butter for 2 minutes per side, until golden.
Top with the onions and serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Chicken paprikash
ingredients: Egg noodles or dumplings to serve
steps: Season the chicken with salt. Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Brown the chicken in the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat for 5 minutes per side. Lift out.
Cook the onions and pepper for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika. It burns easily.
Add the tomato, broth and chicken, cover and simmer on low for 30 minutes, until 165°F (74°C).
Whisk the sour cream and flour, stir in a ladle of the hot sauce, then stir it all back into the pot.
Simmer gently for 2 minutes and serve over noodles.

recipes.name: Moussaka
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground lamb or beef
1 cup (100 g) grated parmesan or kefalotyri
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Brush the eggplant with oil, sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt and roast on sheet pans for 20 to 25 minutes, flipping once, until soft.
Cook the onion in 1 tablespoon oil in a big pan over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and meat and cook for 8 minutes, until browned. Drain.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, cinnamon, oregano and 1/2 teaspoon salt and simmer for 15 minutes.

Melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick. Off the heat, whisk in the yolks, nutmeg, the rest of the salt and half the cheese.
Turn the oven to 350°F (175°C). Layer half the eggplant, all the meat, the rest of the eggplant in a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Pour the white sauce over and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes, until golden. Rest for 20 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts, cut in 1 1/2 inch cubes
8 skewers (soak wooden ones in water for 30 minutes)
Pita, tzatziki, tomato and red onion to serve
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes. Ask an adult to help, and wash your hands after.
Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper and coat the chicken. Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Heat a grill pan or the broiler to high. An adult should do this.
Cook the skewers for 10 to 12 minutes, turning every few minutes, until charred and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Serve with pita, tzatziki, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken and potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) Yukon gold potatoes, cut in wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help cut the potatoes.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss the potatoes with half the mix in a big roasting pan and spread them out.
Coat the chicken with the rest and nestle it skin side up between the potatoes. Wash your hands.
Pour the broth around the potatoes.
Roast for 50 to 60 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and golden and the chicken is 175°F (79°C), safely past 165°F (74°C).
Spoon the pan juices over before serving.

recipes.name: Beef kofta kebabs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) ground beef or lamb
Pita, tahini or yogurt sauce, and salad to serve
steps: Grate the onion and chop the parsley. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the meat, onion, parsley, garlic, spices, salt and pepper well with your hands.
Split into 8 pieces and squeeze each around a skewer into a long sausage shape. Wash your hands.
Chill for 15 minutes so they hold their shape.
Cook in a grill pan or under a broiler on high for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and 160°F (71°C) inside. An adult should help.
Serve with pita, sauce and salad.

recipes.name: Oven chicken shawarma
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
Pita, garlic sauce or tahini, pickles, tomato and lettuce
steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, spices and salt and coat the chicken. Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes to overnight. Wash your hands.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the chicken and onion on a lined sheet pan.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, until charred at the edges and 165°F (74°C).
Rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Wrap in warm pita with sauce, pickles, tomato and lettuce.

recipes.name: Joojeh kabab Persian saffron chicken
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless chicken thighs or breasts, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, ground with a pinch of sugar
Rice and grilled tomatoes to serve
steps: Steep the ground saffron in the hot water for 10 minutes.
Mix the yogurt, onion, lemon juice, oil, salt and most of the saffron water and coat the chicken. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes, up to overnight. Wash your hands.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Heat the broiler or a grill pan to high. An adult should do this.
Cook for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and 165°F (74°C).
Mix the melted butter with the rest of the saffron water and brush over the chicken.
Serve with rice and grilled tomatoes.

recipes.name: Stuffed cabbage rolls
steps: An adult cuts the core out of the cabbage and boils the whole head in a big pot for 8 to 10 minutes, peeling off leaves with tongs as they soften. You need about 12.
Trim the thick rib on each leaf so it rolls easily.
Mix the meats, rice, onion, egg, salt and pepper. Wash your hands after.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Put 1/3 cup of filling on each leaf, fold in the sides and roll up.
Mix the tomatoes, tomato sauce, brown sugar and lemon juice. Spread a little in a baking dish.
Lay the rolls seam side down and pour the rest of the sauce over.
Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the filling is 160°F (71°C).

recipes.name: Garlic rosemary lamb chops
ingredients: 8 lamb loin or rib chops, about 1 inch thick
steps: Mix 2 tablespoons oil, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper and rub it on the chops. Let them sit for 15 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the rest of the oil in a heavy pan over medium-high heat. Ask an adult to help, it spatters.
Cook the chops for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until 145°F (63°C) inside.
Rest for 5 minutes and squeeze lemon over the top.

recipes.name: Baked chicken Kiev
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more for the chicken
steps: Mix the butter, garlic, herbs and salt, shape into 4 small logs on plastic wrap and freeze for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Pound each breast to 1/4 inch thick between plastic wrap and season with salt.
Lay a butter log on each, roll up tightly and tuck in the sides so it's sealed.
Coat in flour, then egg, then panko. Dip in egg and panko a second time. Wash your hands.
Set seam side down on a lined sheet and spray with oil.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden and 165°F (74°C). Rest for 5 minutes. Careful, hot butter pours out when you cut it.
